1:
To navigate around your office, you’ll need to click on one of the
entrances. You’ll be able to go to the vents, the hallway, the
ceiling, and finally under the desk. At each entrance (except
for the desk), you can use the flashlight by holding down
[Ctrl]. Only in the vents, however, can you use the
mask by pressing [Shift]

If you hear a radio, go to the ceiling and shine the
flashlight on it until the danger goes away.

If you hear someone coming from the vents and they’re
green, use the mask; if they’re red, look at their eyes; if
they can see you, use the mask; if they can’t see you,
hide under the desk.
2:
The blue guys aren't fooled by the mask. If one
of them dares to attack you from the vents,
hide under the desk.

A mushroom has also just sprouted tonight; if you
hear its laughter coming from the left vent, turn
your flashlight on and off repeatedly until it
leaves you alone.

Otherwise, everything else is the same.
Good luck.
3:
That other blue guy will try to slowly approach
your position from the hallway. You can keep an
eye on him via the monitor above your desk; if
you hear him laughing, shine your flashlight
on him until he goes away.

You're close to the truth, Amy.
4:
An old acquaintance of yours will be joining us tonight.
She won't be very dangerous, but if she tries to attack
you, hide under the desk. Nothing too complicated.
5:
Everyone you've met so far will be more aggressive
tonight, but not for long... Things are going to
change, and when they do, keep this in mind:

from the vents to the mask,
from the hallway to the desk,
from the ceiling to the flashlight.

It's time to shine.
